responsibility: This file supplies the minimal driver-spec hooks required for libgccjit’s dummy frontend to link into GCC’s language framework. It defines no-op implementations of lang_specific_driver, lang_specific_pre_link, and the extra-outfiles count so the JIT frontend satisfies the driver interface without adding command-line processing or link-time behavior of its own. Its responsibility is stub frontend/driver integration rather than any JIT compilation logic.
